provider.name: Caffeinate
provider.description: Pause idle actions for a duration

action.startFiniteDescription: Pause idle actions until this duration expires
action.replaceFiniteDescription: Replace the current session with this duration
action.startIndefiniteDescription: Pause idle actions until you explicitly end the session
action.replaceIndefiniteDescription: Replace the current session and keep caffeinating until stopped

status.offDescription: Idle-triggered actions are using their normal settings
status.indefiniteDescription: Idle-triggered actions stay paused until you end the session

incomplete.title: Keep typing a duration
incomplete.missing-unit: Add a unit such as s, m, h, d, or w
incomplete.missing-component: Add another duration component after the separator
incomplete.missing-clock-field: Complete the clock form, for example 1:30 or ::30

invalid.title: That duration is not valid
invalid.unsupported-unit: Use seconds, minutes, hours, days, or weeks
invalid.expected-number: Start each duration component with a number
invalid.unexpected-token: Remove the unsupported punctuation or word
invalid.below-minimum: The rounded duration must be at least one second
invalid.clock-minute-range: Clock-form minutes must be between 0 and 59
invalid.clock-second-range: Clock-form seconds must be between 0 and 59
invalid.clock-empty-field: Only leading clock fields may be empty; use ::30 for 30 seconds
invalid.clock-field-width: Clock-form minutes and seconds use one or two digits
invalid.clock-numeric-field: Clock-form fields must contain whole numbers

bar.finiteTooltip:
Caffeinating — {duration} remaining
Left-click: session menu · Right-click: settings
bar.indefiniteTooltip:
Caffeinating until stopped
Left-click: session menu · Right-click: settings
bar.inactiveTooltip:
Caffeinate is off
Left-click: session menu · Right-click: settings

panel.title: Caffeinate
panel.presetsDescription: Choose a configured duration, or open the launcher to enter another.
panel.noPresets: No presets are configured. Open the launcher to enter a duration.

settings.title: Caffeinate
settings.description: Configure launcher shortcuts, session presets, and bar behavior.

alias.label: Command alias
alias.description: Optional shorter launcher word. Leave empty to disable it.
alias.formatError: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens without spaces or a leading >
alias.duplicateError: The alias must differ from caffeinate

presets.title: Duration presets
presets.description: These shortcuts appear when the provider opens with no duration.
presets.invalid: Enter a valid duration from one second through 52 weeks

indefinite.label: Show Until stopped
indefinite.description: Include an indefinite session among the blank-query presets

bar.title: Bar widget
bar.description: Choose how Caffeinate appears between sessions.

hideInactive.label: Hide when inactive
hideInactive.description: Remove the widget from the bar when there is no current session
